summary: Clean and current, but too easy for Today's list under the current bar: the casual player found 9 and was only stopped by losing all 5 lives on recent champions with 2 wins. Good free play, mostly for US players.
reasons: Casual found 9 of 10 and lost all 5 lives on Eagles, Seahawks, Rams, Bucs and Ravens, each #11 with 2 wins. The fan found 10 for 1 life. The bar is 6 to 8, and the crowd estimate averages about 6.3, above the 5 to 6 target.

The curve is front-loaded: seven famous franchises are gimmes for a US player, Broncos and Raiders come with thought, and only Washington is a stretch. The trap is fair (every miss shows a number) but harsh: the 2-win group holds four of the last six champions, and 22 of the 32 teams cost a life.

Ranking: 20 teams have won (not 12; 12 never have). #10 vs #11 is clean (3 vs 2). Seven tie at #11, three at #18. Inside the top 10, tied teams take the source table's order, so the board calls the Steelers 2nd on 6, the same as the Patriots. That doesn't change what counts, but a Steelers fan will notice.
It has been in random play since before launch, and the owner wants dailies fresh. Data holds until Super Bowl LXI in February 2027.
fixes: Drop alias 'Football Team' from Washington Commanders: typing the list's subject, 'football team', hands over #10. Keep 'Washington Football Team' and 'Washington FT'.
